arStrings.szText: Welcome to Season 14! Close {c_highlight}Surging Ruptures{/c} in {icon:Marker_Helltide, 2.5} Helltide Zones and achieve mastery for a rare chance to spawn a {c_highlight}Realmwalker{/c}.
Defeating a {c_highlight}Realmwalker{/c} opens a portal that leads into {c_highlight}The Deathtoll Chamber{/c}.

Expand the Rupture ring before time runs out within {c_highlight}The Deathtoll Chamber{/c} to earn more rewards! Rewards can include {c_highlight}Greater Lair Boss Keys{/c} in Torment 1+ to open a lair boss.
Use {c_highlight}Pandemonium Fragments{/c} along with Unique items to craft {c_mythic}Mythic Unique{/c} items in the Horadric Cube.
